policy.description: Illustrative release thresholds chosen before model comparison. Not industry standards. Mean fallback only requires finite predictions and verified artifacts; learned models must also beat the mean, meet error limits and have adequate validation department samples. Candidate must beat the ridge incumbent. No replay score enters release eligibility.

frozen_experiment.scope: Release eligibility uses validation only; replay labels have not been scored here.
